name: LocalPilot Initial Providers Database
description: Authoritative registry of foundational AI research laboratories, institutes, and organizations creating open model weights as of October 20, 2026.

providers.name: Google
providers.description: Developer of the lightweight, state-of-the-art Gemma 2 and Gemma 3 open model family inspired by Gemini research.

providers.name: Meta
providers.description: Pioneers of the industry-defining Llama series of foundational open weights across dense and multimodal architectures.

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.legal_name: Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd.
providers.description: Creators of breakthrough open-weight reasoning and coding models including DeepSeek-R1 and DeepSeek-V3 with native Mixture-of-Experts (MoE).

providers.name: Mistral AI
providers.description: European AI laboratory creating highly efficient open models including Mistral 7B, Mixtral MoE, Ministral, Codestral, and Pixtral.

providers.name: Microsoft
providers.description: Pioneers of High-Quality Small Language Models (SLMs) with the Phi-3.5 and Phi-4 families trained on curated textbook-grade synthetic data.

providers.name: Qwen Team
providers.description: Comprehensive multilingual open model family excelling in coding, math, long-context comprehension, and multimodal vision.

providers.name: NVIDIA
providers.description: High-performance enterprise open models optimized for hardware acceleration and reasoning, including Nemotron and Megatron.

providers.name: Cohere

providers.name: AllenAI

providers.name: OpenBMB
